rochonrealestate.com
"Create a modern, professional, high-conversion real estate agent website for Dillon Rochon, a REALTOR® with 2% Realty serving Southern Alberta, Canada (primary areas: Pincher Creek, Lethbridge, Crowsnest Pass, Fort Macleod).
Use a clean, trustworthy, contemporary design inspired by premium real estate sites, with strong emphasis on user experience, fast loading, mobile-responsiveness, and SEO optimization.
Branding and Colors (2% Realty inspired):

Primary color: Deep/royal blue tones for trust and professionalism (e.g., #002366 or similar dark blue for headers/navigation/accents).
Accent color: Vibrant green or teal for calls-to-action, savings highlights, and '2%' elements (e.g., #00A651 or fresh green to evoke savings/value).
Secondary accents: Clean white (#FFFFFF) background, light gray (#F5F7FA) sections, dark gray (#333333) for text.
Highlight '2%' commission prominently in bold green or a standout color.
Overall feel: Professional yet approachable, modern minimalist with plenty of white space, high-quality hero images of Southern Alberta landscapes/homes.

Key Pages and Structure:

Home Page (Hero-focused):
Large hero section with high-resolution background image of scenic Southern Alberta (mountains, prairies, homes) overlaid with text: 'Real Estate Made Easy with Dillon Rochon – Your Southern Alberta Real Estate Expert' and subtitle '100% Full Service | Only 2% Commissions | Save Thousands'.
Prominent CTA buttons: 'Free Home Evaluation', 'Contact Me', 'View Listings' – with smooth hover animations and micro-interactions.
Animated sections: Smooth scroll animations (fade-in, slide-up), parallax effects on hero/background images.
Quick stats/savings calculator teaser showing how much clients save vs traditional 5-7% commissions.
Featured listings carousel (MLS integration placeholders).
Testimonials slider with client quotes.

About Page:
Professional headshot of Dillon Rochon (use placeholder if needed).
Bio: Dillon is a seasoned professional with 14+ years in law enforcement (training/project management background), passionate about stress-free real estate. Impressed by 2% Realty when selling his own home, he got licensed to bring full-service, low-commission realty to Pincher Creek and Southern Alberta. Mission: Seamless transactions, professionalism, helping buyers/sellers/investors keep more of their investment.
Timeline or icons highlighting experience, 2% Realty affiliation, areas served.

Buyers Page:
Benefits of working with Dillon: Dream home search, market guidance, negotiation support.
Search form integration (property search placeholder).

Sellers Page:
Emphasize 2% flat commission (full listing/selling services, no hidden fees).
Marketing strategies, professional photography, MLS/Realtor.ca exposure, virtual tours.
Free home evaluation form.

Contact Page:
Advanced, user-friendly contact form with fields: Name, Email, Phone, Message, Property Address (optional), Type (Buying/Selling/Investing/General).
Map embed of Southern Alberta/Pincher Creek area.
Phone, email, social links.
Success animation on form submission (confetti or smooth thank-you message).

Additional Pages/Features:
Listings/Properties page with grid/carousel view, filters (price, type, location), placeholders for MLS/IDX integration.
Blog/Resources section (placeholders for market updates, Southern Alberta living guides).
Testimonials page or integrated throughout.
FAQ section covering 2% model differences, services included, timelines.


Must-Have Features:

Great Forms: Modern, animated forms (floating labels, progress indicators, validation, smooth transitions). Include: Contact, Home Evaluation (address, property type, email/phone), Buyer Questionnaire.
Animations: Subtle yet engaging – GSAP-style or Framer Motion equivalents: fade-ins on scroll, hover scale/glow on buttons/cards, smooth page transitions, animated counters for savings stats, parallax scrolling on sections.
Other Modern Elements: Sticky navigation with subtle shadow, dark mode toggle (optional), fast performance, accessibility (ARIA), HTTPS-ready.
Calls to Action: Floating WhatsApp/phone button, multiple 'Message Me' or 'Schedule Call' buttons with Calendly integration placeholder.
Footer: Contact info, social icons, 2% Realty logo/link, areas served list, copyright.

Generate the full website with placeholder images of professional real estate photography (Southern Alberta homes, landscapes, happy clients). Make it conversion-focused, trustworthy, and visually appealing to stand out from traditional realtor sites. Use modern typography (e.g., sans-serif fonts like Inter or Poppins for body, bold headings). Ensure it's easy to edit/customize later."

**Defining the Focus**

I'm solidifying the core focus: a modern, professional, high-conversion real estate website for Dillon Rochon, specifying Southern Alberta locations like Pincher Creek and Lethbridge. I've also nailed down the color scheme, leaning toward a deep blue and vibrant green.


**Outlining Core Features**

I'm now detailing the site's feature set. Key sections will be Home, About, Buyers, Sellers, Contact, Listings, and FAQ. I'm focusing on user experience, planning animated forms, scroll animations, and a savings calculator. I'm also ensuring sticky navigation and a responsive design. I've started outlining the component and file structure.

Things to do in the area with phone numbers/websites listed for each. 

For Pincher creek, I want a selector on the top to go to different landing pages with further options for each of the communities in the MD, Walking Plow estates, Cowley, Lundbreck etc. with local landmarks such as the dam and lundbreck falls. Each area/community is to have it's own landing page. 

For Crowsnest Pass I want a selector on the page for each community, Blairmore, Coleman, Hillcrest, Bellevue, Frank. Each with it's own landing page. 

I also want the MD's to have their own page, so one for Pincher MD, Willow Creek, Lethbridge County.

I also want Lethbridge to be broken up into each community within Lethbridge. So there will be a landing page for Lethbridge General, but on the top will be a nav dropdown selector with a landing page for each community in Lethbridge with to do's, schools, places to eat, etc for each community.
